note: The game calendar. Days run sunset to sunset and are counted 1, 2, 3 ... with no real date. Day 1 is the first day of the week. A year is twelve 30-day months plus five extra days at the end. The week never resets: every seventh day is the Sabbath whatever the month or year. Weekday names are ordinal, as in the New Testament (Mark 16:2, Acts 20:7).
